It is a foil printing of the [[A New Hope]] card.[[:File:Reflections-Foil-L-Attack-Run-PSA-72605733-original.jpg|Original printed Reflections foil face]], PSA certification 72605733. |game_text=Deploy on Death Star: Trench.
During your move phase, you may make an Attack Run as follows:
'''Enter Trench:''' Move up to 3 of your starfighters into trench (for free). Dark Side may immediately follow with up to 3 TIEs (for free).
'''Provide Cover:''' Identify your lead starfighter (Proton Torpedoes* required) and wingmen (if any). Turbolaser Batteries and TIEs with weapons may now target your starfighters (wingmen first, then lead if no wingmen remaining). Hit starfighters are immediately lost.
'''It’s Away!:''' Draw two destiny.
'''Pull Up!:''' All starfighters now move to Death Star system (for free).
If (total destiny + X + Y - Z) > 15, Death Star is “blown away.”
X = ability of lead pilot or 3 if Targeting Computer is present.
Y = total sites at largest Rebel Base (Yavin 4 or Hoth).
Z = highest ability of TIE pilots in trench.
*Your Proton Torpedoes are immune to Overload. |versions='''Decipher''' — [[Attack Run]]

'''Card text:''' *Power = √3 (X−Y) +2 (A−B) + π (power is at least 1). X is the Dark Side hand size. Y is the Light Side hand size. A is the total Dark icons on table. B is the total Light icons on table. π is 3.141592653589793238462643383… '''Lore:''' Boshek gave this Sanyassan male the nickname Brainiac (big-headed). True to the name, he can calculate hyperspace coordinates in his head. If only he had been the one to plan Leia's escape… '''Comparison with the English printing:''' The Japanese lore glosses the nickname as 頭でっかち. |notes='''Brainiac (Japanese Reflections II Foil)''' is a Japanese-language foil printing of [[Brainiac|Brainiac]]. Complete Card List v4 lists checklist R56 at rarity SR. Collector R-numbers are checklist references, not GEMP blueprint IDs.[https://res.starwarsccg.org/Resources/swccgcardlist4.0.pdf Star Wars Customizable Card Game Complete Card List v4.0], p. 30, Reflections II foil cards, R56.
